# opstracer_notification_order (Resource)

The org-wide order in which channels are tried when paging a responder. One per org; destroying it only removes it from state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opstracer_notification_order" "org" {
  enabled = true
  tiers = [
    { channels = ["slack", "push"] },
    { channels = ["sms"], delay_seconds = 120 },
    { channels = ["voice"], delay_seconds = 300 },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the custom order is used. When false, the default order applies.
- `tiers` (Attributes List) Tried in order. Each channel may appear once across all tiers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tiers))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `notification_order`.

<a id="nestedatt--tiers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tiers`

Required:

- `channels` (List of String) e.g. `slack`, `email`, `telegram`, `push`, `sms`, `voice`.

Optional:

- `delay_seconds` (Number) Seconds to wait after the previous tier before trying this one. 0 to 900.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import opstracer_notification_order.org notification_order
```
